title: eligibility.formal_confirmation_recorded event payload (v1)
description: docs/canonical/TZ-00-domain-event-canon.md, section 19d.12 (canon-0.6.0, PACK-07, ADR-030). Produced by epd2_eligibility_service.events.build_formal_confirmation_recorded_event, emitted once an AssemblyDecision reaches a terminal status (confirmed/rejected/returned_for_revision). Carries final_legal_decision and, where applicable, divergence_explanation - the confirming authority's own recorded outcome, never a re-statement of the originating DigitalDecision.digital_result.
